facts.fact: Faydaverse told Capital that citizens currently access the FaydaPass digital wallet with their Fayda digital ID, free of charge.
Faydaverse said nine government institutions, including those for trade and transport, have joined the FaydaPass credential platform.
Faydaverse said citizens currently use the FaydaPass digital credential wallet, reached with the Fayda digital ID, to access and verify credentials remotely.
